description: How the radar's tracker chooses the cars in the two target-summary pairs (0x191-0x194): ranking by longitudinal range, persistence of a displayed car, what leaves and returns. Derived from the radar's own published state with the object list linked to summary runs by association; radar-witness authority (no physical reference). Sets: owner car, second car set 1 (discovery), second car sets 2 and 3 (held out, rules frozen first).

sets.second_2: second car, held out (408 segments with summaries)

slot_order.note: share of two-summary cycles in which slot 0 (0x191 / 0x192) is the nearer car; lateral signs of the two cars agree on 58-62 % of cycles

rival_pairs.note: strictly eligible rivals in the same cycle (displayed D versus non-displayed R); share of pairs in which the displayed car has the smaller key

exact_set_on_change_cycles.note: cycles on which the displayed set changes (entries and exits); stateless rule, two places

displacement_by_leaver_range.note: a car leaves a full pair and a newcomer takes the place; share in which the newcomer is farther than the leaver, by the leaver's last range (all four sets pooled)
displacement_by_leaver_range.leaver_below_10_m: the leaver is the nearest of the three cars (median exit range 3.8-4.5 m, 14 % at negative range) and the next car in line refills the slot

exits.note: exits of a pair code from the displayed pair at ego > 1 m/s; 26.1 moving h on the owner car and three second-car groups

tracker_tracks_without_list_counterpart.note: 0x680 object frames above 5 m/s of moving vehicles that are neither the ACC car nor a summary car
